sources.title: How to do DESTRUCTION with vlad

passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.text: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

spells.name: Transfusion
spells.text: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

spells.name: Sanguine Pool
spells.text: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

spells.name: Tides of Blood
spells.text: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

spells.name: Hemoplague
spells.text: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

damage.value: Vladimir deals delayed burst magic damage with Hemoplague.

archetype.value: Vladimir is a mage who trades health for damage and restores it by siphoning enemies.

axis.value: Vladimir keeps the wave near his turret to farm safely and trades with an empowered Q when possible.

winCondition.value: Vladimir wins by reaching late game, sustaining through fights, and running down the enemy team.

spikes.why: Vladimir scales strongly with gold, making farm his most reliable income.
Vladimir becomes less weak after his difficult early levels.
Vladimir’s Transfusion briefly gains greatly increased damage and healing.

bait.why: Vladimir loses his 2-second untargetability while Sanguine Pool is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Vladimir gives up safe farm by failing to keep caster minions alive when setting up a wave near his turret.
Vladimir can waste Tides of Blood’s health cost by releasing it into enemy units that block it.
